mentions.name: Cross-platform podcast app
mentions.description: A cross-platform podcast app with a server-client architecture and full offline support, built with Dioxus and Axum, targeting web and mobile, with plans to open-source the code and release it on the App Store.
mentions.problem: Existing podcast apps fall short: it aims to match most of AntennaPod's features while having fewer bugs and quirks than Podverse.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a cross platform podcast app. Server client but with full* offline support. Written with Dioxus + Axum and targets web and mobile.
